response.justification: Bogdan is a capable Staff-level engineer with 15+ years of experience and strong credentials in distributed systems, scale, and architectural thinking. However, he lacks the core domain expertise critical for this Principal role: no demonstrated experience building experimentation platforms, measurement infrastructure, or growth systems. The job specifically requires 4+ years of experimentation platform experience and high data/metrics aptitude—neither evident in his resume. While he could potentially learn this domain, for a Principal IC6 role focused on experimentation systems, a candidate with direct platform-building experience would be significantly stronger.
strengths: Strong technical foundation with 15+ years across multiple required languages (TypeScript, Java, C/C++); currently Staff-level showing sustained advancement and architectural contributions

Proven ability to build systems at enterprise scale (Dunnhumby: millions of req/sec with low-latency; Optilyz: millions of emails annually) with deep experience in distributed systems and microservices

Versatile engineer demonstrating solid architectural thinking through infrastructure work (CI/CD, Kubernetes, testing frameworks) and open-source contributions showing systems-thinking beyond day-to-day coding
concerns: No demonstrated experience building experimentation platforms, A/B testing systems, or feature-flagging infrastructure—core competencies for this experimentation-focused Principal role
Limited evidence of data/metrics/telemetry expertise or statistical analysis background; no track record collaborating with data science on experimental quality, bias detection, or analysis workflows
Career trajectory is general backend/full-stack engineering rather than growth/measurement product focus; missing evidence of translating ambiguous business goals into measurable engineering systems
